note: The key set serves declaration_keys as the declaration key at 3 and the number 7. An entry that is not an object is an entry the reader cannot read as a key (R6.62(a)), so the key set supplies no usable member and the verdict is could not be checked; a reader that skips the item disputes, one that refuses the document reports an error and no verdict. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under its kind's header typ with its role's member as the header kid (spec 4.5); the head is signed by a fixed Ed25519 log key. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
